FN-MSYFE11-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 102
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Kerry (Bubba)
Security Underwood
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 01/13/2026
House Bill 102 as introduced would decrease potential receipts to the State General Fund, the
Public Road and Bridge Fund, and to municipalities and counties by an undetermined amount
dependent on the number of surviving spouses of a deceased disabled veteran that retain the
veteran’s disabled license plate, as provided by this bill that otherwise would have obtained a
different license plate and paid the regular license fee, instead of the reduced $5 fee.
Page 1

FN-MSYFE11-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 102
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Sponsor: Representative Kerry (Bubba)
Security Underwood
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 01/22/2026
House Bill 102 as reported by the Committee on Public Safety and Homeland Security would
decrease potential receipts to the State General Fund, the Public Road and Bridge Fund, and to
municipalities and counties by an undetermined amount dependent on the difference in: 1)
amount of license fees collected from surviving spouses of a deceased disabled veteran that: are
issued a "Disabled Veteran Spouse" license plate and pay the $5 issuance fee, as provided by
this bill; and 2) the amount of regular license fees that otherwise would have been collected
from the purchase of a different license plate.
